and time again I have stepped away from reviewing this surgery’s awful receptionists.  Weeks ago we were incorrectly informed by a receptionist that test results were good (this was not factually correct), the symptoms remained and so returned for more tests with a now added complication.  Today, we have been waiting for a call since 1030 for the potentially life threatening/changing results.  1030 passed, 1130 passed, 1200 passed.  Approaching 1230, I call the surgery again to find out where the call is, to be told they had used a number a decade out of date despite the number to call being confirmed at the appt and the surgery ringing the correct contact number just 24hrs earlier to make the 1030 appt today!

Asking the receptionist 3 times at what point they tried to call the correct number, it was alledgedly 1148, no call or answer phone message was received at this time.  Absolutely frustrated at this, I’m accused of being hostile when I try to ask for the results that were due at 1030 are relayed prior to their lunch at 1300, I don’t think this is unreasonable considering the original appt time.  That is not going to happen.  We are also not allowed to go to the surgery either.

Fortunately I have the call recorded and will submit this farce to NHS England bypassing an incompetent PM who continues to allow this type of service to remain. Receptionists, you need to understand the difference between your accusation of hostility versus frustration that a promised appt time that the surgery made to the correct number just 24hrs earlier has not been adhered to.

Update:  Call finally received at 1504, just under 5hrs later than arranged by the surgery.  Doctor was reminded that a 3rd nut allergy test was taken which is acceptable considering the large footfall, but why on earth arrange this appt without having hastened the most critical test, so all results were present?  Surely all tests were in the notes?  Give us strength when we have to go through this cluster again in 2 weeks time chasing results.  In the meantime, we just hope we avoid whatever the allergen is as we have no idea and no Epi
